graph.name: 3. Give the planner only the context it needs
graph.description:
Select a small public scene window and observe what the planner omits.

Assign this independent copy as Unified and arm Lattice before Send. Ordinary generation uses Active SillyTavern.
Bind Analysis to Active SillyTavern or a configured local model.

Open Give the planner only the context it needs and inspect the named pins.
Inspect the Scene Context omission report for older/restricted material.
Compare the four-message context with the resulting one-beat plan.
Send in a disposable story, inspect checkpoints, then explicitly Apply or Reject. Preview never publishes or settles proposals.

Calls: 1 auxiliary Response Plan request; one ordinary native generation; no retries.
Checkpoints:
Scene Context · public window.out: Public recent context and omissions exclude restricted host material.
Response Plan · bounded public plan.out: One public next-beat plan reaches native Guidance.

plan.title: Response Plan
plan.instructions: Plan one next scene beat from only the public recent messages. Name what remains unknown; do not infer private motives.
